pack_write_agents: None — all 72 agents are read-only (analysis, reporting, verification, or board decision). No agent writes to pack files.

agent_coordination_patterns.sequential_pipeline: A through Z — each agent depends on specific predecessors (S301, most sessions)
agent_coordination_patterns.board_governance: Y (Chair) synthesizes all agent outputs into final board decision; Z (Closure) verifies cross-reference consistency (S301)
agent_coordination_patterns.specialist_parallel: D (DL-008), E (Distractor), F (Explanation), G (Blueprint) — independent specialist audits of same data (S301)
agent_coordination_patterns.hierarchical_certification: C (Census) → D/E/F/G (Defect) → H (Model) → I (Section) → J (Portfolio) → L/M (Planning) → P/Y (Board) (S301)
agent_coordination_patterns.governance_hardening: A/B (Detection) → C (Spec) → D (Guard upgrade) → H (Closure gate) → Y (Board) (S725-S726)
